title: Chemistry

exam.name: Unit tests, labs & finals
exam.note: Assessed through unit tests, lab reports, and semester finals. California courses align to NGSS; unit order varies by teacher — confirm the sequence with yours.

overview: The study of matter — what it's made of, how it changes, and the math that describes those changes. Chemistry rewards two habits: understanding the particle-level 'why' behind each rule, and being fluent with the arithmetic (units, moles, balancing). The strand that connects most units is the mole and stoichiometry.
how_to_study_course: Keep units attached to every number and cancel them — unit tracking (dimensional analysis) catches most mistakes.
Understand the mole early; it's the bridge between the atomic world and grams you can weigh, and it powers most of the course.
Rework lab and homework problems until the method is automatic — chemistry is learned by doing problems, not rereading notes.
Draw particle-level pictures (atoms, bonds, collisions) so the abstract rules have a mental image behind them.

resources.label: The Organic Chemistry Tutor (YouTube — general chem too)

units.title: Unit 1 — Matter, Measurement & Lab Safety
how_to_study: Nail sig figs and unit conversions now — they're used all year
Practice classifying changes as physical vs chemical

units.title: Unit 2 — Atomic Structure & the Periodic Table
how_to_study: Learn to read periodic trends from position, not memorization

units.title: Unit 3 — Chemical Bonding
how_to_study: Master naming/formula-writing — it's the vocabulary of the rest of the course
Draw Lewis structures step by step

units.title: Unit 4 — The Mole & Stoichiometry
how_to_study: This is the heart of the course — over-practice mole conversions
Balance first, then use the ratio; keep units on every step

units.title: Unit 5 — Reactions & Energy
how_to_study: Learn to predict products by reaction type

units.title: Unit 6 — States of Matter & Gas Laws
topics: Gas laws (Boyle, Charles, ideal gas PV=nRT)
how_to_study: Keep temperature in Kelvin for every gas-law problem
Relate boiling points to intermolecular forces

units.title: Unit 7 — Solutions, Acids & Bases
how_to_study: Understand pH as a log scale, not just a number
